children.text: C16 · Enhance Progression Table — 3 UI Layout Variants
children.name: Title

children.text: Compare 3 UI layouts for adding a progression comparison table to Screen C16 (Enhance popup 3539:29395). Shows Coral Rod +0…+10 stat growth (+4% compound), costs, and milestones. No checkmarks, bullets, or emojis.
children.name: Sub

children.text: Tap any row to preview or view full +0…+10 table
children.name: Note

children.text: Exact compound stat growth and coin sink formulas used in Aura Fishing economy.
children.name: Desc

children.text: 1. Stat Multiplier: Stat = Base * (1.04 ^ level). Each level gives +4% compound stat boost (+48.0% total at +10).
2. Affected Stats: Luck, Reel Power, Catch Bar Size, Resilience (Rod stats scaled simultaneously).
3. Upgrade Cost: math.floor(Price * 0.1 * 1.5 ^ level). Costs scale exponentially (1.2k -> 46.1k for Coral Rod).
4. Phase 2 Materials: Enhancing from +6 to +10 requires Enhance Stones (x2, x3, x4, x5, x6).
5. Safety Guarantee: Enhancing NEVER breaks or downgrades items. It is 100% permanent progression.
Trade-offs for the 3 progression table designs to guide player experience and UI implementation.
children.name: Desc

children.text: Option A (Dual-Panel Modal, 860x540): Best for PC / Tablet. Immediate visibility of current step and entire +0…+10 ladder side-by-side with zero clicks.
Option B (Tabbed Modal, 540x560): Keeps existing compact popup size. Switch tabs to inspect full ladder; includes quick upgrade button directly inside table.
Option C (Milestone Ladder, 500x560): Best for Mobile! Shows only the 4 key milestones (+0 Base, +3 Current, +4 Next, +10 Peak) without overwhelming screen space.
Recommendation: Implement Option C as standard mobile view, with an expandable table sheet (Option B/A) for deeper inspection.
